sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: Impulsive action kicks in as you work and interact today. Do not let the pressure and strain cloud your thoughts, and instead focus on acting on the things at hand.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: You realize the exuberance and excitement that come when you come out of hiding and let your playful spirit charm the world. Put serious subjects aside and make time to have fun and be more social.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Bet on yourself and invest in your dreams, dearest Taurus, as the Sagittarius Moon aligns with Neptune, Pluto, and Uranus. These cosmic conditions help you see further into the future and make smart decisions that lead to the life you desire. However, use discernment, especially with financial investments. Focus on practical aspirations you've considered for some time, rather than impulsive desires that suddenly arise. Build upon existing foundations instead of starting from scratch.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Today's entertainment should include sports activities and outdoor events. Your creative talents will prove to be highly lucrative if put to proper use. Spend some relaxed moments with family members. Emotional disturbances could trouble you. Pending projects and plans move to take a final shape. In any case, you should not waste your precious time. Remember to cherish the time, as once its gone, it won't ever come back. Your spouse might tell you some not-so-good things about being with you today.

readings.text: Someone may try to find flaws in your work and this may make you a little defensive. You may feel sad and may not take the aggressive approach today. As a result, things may not speed up and get completed on time. Taking help from others would be a clever idea.

A big theme for you today will be "personal space". It is important that when you are working, you have well-defined boundaries - both physical and mental. Make sure that other people respect and honor these boundaries. Your space is important.

Ideas are flying, but you need to monetize one before moving on to the next lest you find yourself with decreased cash flow. A lot is changing there, requiring you to be diplomatic with your attention at this time.

readings.text: A great day is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. This is the perfect time to finish your pending work and take up new projects. Energy level shall move upwards, you may easily complete your tasks by end of the day. Do not neglect any health issues.

The current challenge for you is to find your balance among the various elements of life. In astrological terms, the elements are fire, earth, air, and water. In daily life terms, they are the spirit, the body, the intellect, and the emotions. Your natural interest in alternative medicine, psychology, health foods and nature point the way to a healthy balance. Paying attention to the needs of your body nurtures your basic well-being.

lucky.remedy: To bring in more auspiciousness to your love life, eat sugar before meeting your lover.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: Conversations are the name of the game today -- skip the small talk and go deep.
